item.title: [RFC] Upgrade VolatilePair hook and update X Layer releaser (uniswap)
item.description: Uniswap Labs proposes an RFC with two technical updates: upgrading the VolatilePair hook on Ethereum to cap its temporary fee by block gap, and updating the protocol fee releaser on X Layer.
